callees.name: _llm_status_style
callees.pre_condition: code and status are values obtained from an item in state.llm_statuses. Either or both may be None if the corresponding keys are absent from the item dictionary.
callees.post_condition: Returns a tuple (color, label) where color is a Rich-compatible style name and label is a string. The mapping from (code, status) input pairs to (color, label) output pairs is deterministic: identical inputs always produce identical outputs.
